concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one standalone square iOS app icon concept for Workoutes, a native personal strength workout and exercise notes app that organizes routines, tracks sets/reps/weight, marks completed exercises, and indicates increasing load next time.
Vibe: calm, focused, personal, quietly confident, friendly premium native iOS. Its actual accent is petrol blue #326884, with white rounded cards, soft ambient gradients and subtle glass accents.
Composition: single centered distinctive bold symbol occupying about 65% of image, generous clear margins, exact front view, full bleed square opaque background. Icon artwork fills whole image; no outer mockup, no phone, no contact sheet, no separate rounded tile floating on another background. The OS will supply corner masking.
Constraints: exceptionally legible at small app icon sizes, few substantial shapes, balanced negative space, no tiny detail, no labels, no wordmarks, no watermark. Do not use logos of existing brands.
Primary request: a fresh stylized horizontal dumbbell whose central bar and a small confident integrated check gesture read as one coherent mark: strength plus completion. Petrol blue sculpted satin ceramic symbol on warm near-white background, just a subtle shallow dimensional bevel, soft controlled shadow, beautiful broad rounded weight plates. A tiny hint of mint in the check is allowed, but retain one dominant recognizable dumbbell silhouette. Simplicity and visual clarity above literal detail.

Primary request: the workout notebook. One compact ivory training notebook, with a very simple recognizable bold petrol blue dumbbell embossed on the cover. Two large rounded binding loops at the top, no writing, no paper lines, no clutter. Rich petrol blue background with a very soft blue gradient. Slightly dimensional soft ceramic/paper hybrid, face on, elegant broad silhouette. Make the notebook feel like a personal training companion. A graphic simplified object, not photorealistic stationery.

Primary request: an original bold rounded W monogram evoking a strength workout and upward momentum. Form the W from a single broad smooth continuous folded ribbon, with subtly thick weight-like terminal ends. Elegant geometric rhythm and strong silhouette. Ivory matte front surfaces with a subtle translucent petrol-blue edge, on a softly luminous petrol blue / muted mint background. Shallow sculptural depth, restrained material polish, no extra symbols. The W should be instantly readable, distinctive and calm, not a lightning bolt or sharp sports brand logo.

Primary request: a simple symbolic progress ring embracing a short dumbbell. A broad three-quarter circular arc ends in a softly rounded rising arrow at the upper right, surrounding a compact horizontal dumbbell. A cohesive composition of only two simple readable elements. Petrol blue background, luminous pale mint ring, warm white dumbbell, extremely restrained glass depth with solid high-contrast cores. Represents repeating routines and gradually increasing load. Understated, energetic, personal; avoid dashboard/chart details, avoid multiple rings or glossy chrome.
